import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 10000;
    static final int MAX_M = MAX_N * 100;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE >> 5;

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int[] head = new int[MAX_N];
        int[] v = new int[MAX_M];
        int[] nxt = new int[MAX_M];
        long[] w = new long[MAX_M];
        int[] c = new int[MAX_M];
        int[] current = new int[MAX_N];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX_N];
        int[] dist = new int[MAX_N];
        int[] id = new int[MAX_N];
        long cost;
        int ptr, t;

        public FlowNetwork() {
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
            Arrays.fill(nxt, -1);
        }

        void add_edge(int u, int v_, long w_, int c_) {
            this.v[ptr] = v_;
            this.w[ptr] = w_;
            this.c[ptr] = c_;
            this.nxt[ptr] = head[u];
            head[u] = ptr++;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v_, long w_, int c_) {
            add_edge(u, v_, w_, c_);
            add_edge(v_, u, 0, -c_);
        }

        boolean spfa(int s, int t_) {
            Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            dist[s] = 0;
            id[s] = 1;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int node = q.poll();
                visited[node] = false;
                for (int i = head[node]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                    if (w[i] > 0 && (dist[v[i]] == -1 || dist[v[i]] > dist[node] + c[i])) {
                        dist[v[i]] = dist[node] + c[i];
                        if (!visited[v[i]]) {
                            visited[v[i]] = true;
                            q.offer(v[i]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t_] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int pos, long flow) {
            if (pos == t) return flow;
            visited[pos] = true;
            long remaining = flow;
            for (int i = current[pos] != -1 ? current[pos] : head[pos]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (!visited[v[i]] && w[i] > 0 && dist[v[i]] == dist[pos] + c[i]) {
                    current[pos] = i;
                    long pushed = dfs(v[i], Math.min(flow, w[i]));
                    cost += pushed * c[i];
                    w[i] -= pushed;
                    w[i ^ 1] += pushed;
                    flow -= pushed;
                    if (flow == 0) break;
                }
            }
            return remaining - flow;
        }

        long minCostFlow(int s, int t_) {
            cost = 0;
            this.t = t_;
            while (spfa(s, t_)) {
                Arrays.fill(current, -1);
                dfs(s, INF);
            }
            return cost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int kk = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] a = new int[55];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= kk; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        int s = 0;
        int t = n * 100 + 1;
        FlowNetwork flow = new FlowNetwork();

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
            flow.addEdge(i, t, INF, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= kk; i++) {
            flow.addEdge(s, (a[i] - 1) * 100 + 1, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                flow.addEdge((i - 1) * 100 + j, (i - 1) * 100 + j + 1, INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int t1 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int t2 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= kk; j++) {
                    int val = c + d * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1));
                    flow.addEdge((t1 - 1) * 100 + i, (t2 - 1) * 100 + i + 1, 1, val);
                    flow.addEdge((t2 - 1) * 100 + i, (t1 - 1) * 100 + i + 1, 1, val);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flow.minCostFlow(s, t));
    }
}
